note: Core converter design trilogy: topology drives magnetics which drives control
Switch selection chain: topology picks the switch, switch dictates the driver
Switching transition chain: driver speed, spike management, and layout parasitics
EMC chain: filter design verified by layout and measured for compliance
Thermal chain: switch and magnetics losses drive the thermal design
Dynamic performance chain: loop stability, impedance measurement, and transient clamping
Battery power chain: BMS drives thermal and switch requirements for pack charger/discharger
Noise management chain: topology noise profile drives filter and snubber requirements
Physical design chain: magnetics size, thermal path, and board layout are co-dependent
Digital control chain: FPGA timing closure enables digital compensator verified by measurement
Charging system chain: BMS requirements drive converter topology and control for battery charger design
